title: Opencode SQLite session-DB lock under parallel runs
wanted_capability: Per-bro session DB (or some form of per-process SQLite isolation) so concurrent opencode bros don't lock-step on the same DB.
notes: Two opencode bros running concurrently get "database is locked" errors.
resolution_note: Obsolete — opencode provider removed entirely in the beta provider-removal arc (fef32d2, "Restrict dispatch to bro-harness providers"; §4 deletion ledger in design/bro-harness/harness-daemon-boundary.md). No opencode code remains in src/ or crates/; the SQLite session-DB lock concern no longer applies.
